definitions_vs_script.cF: cF n (i, j) = (i + n - support n j) % n : the script's frozen[i] = {(i - x) % n : x in support}, slot j <-> x = support[j] (the script works at palette level and fixes no slot order; this is the only choice made)
definitions_vs_script.cL: cL n (i, j) = (fold n i + 2 * j) % m n : the script's lower[i] = {(h[i] + 2 j) % m}, slot j <-> j
definitions_vs_script.deficit: deficit n = 3 * q n - n  (script deficit)
definitions_vs_script.fold: fold n i = if i < m then i else (i - m) % 2  (script h)
definitions_vs_script.graph: Blow n q on Fin n x Fin q: (i,a)~(j,b) iff i = j /\ a != b, or i != j /\ (j = (i+1) % n \/ i = (j+1) % n); closing edge n-1 ~ 0 included (control2)

theorems.AllOdd.RGraph_not_connected: n odd, 9 <= n -> not (RGraph n (q n) n).Connected: the n-colour reconfiguration graph is disconnected (cF isolated, cLn a different proper n-colouring)
theorems.AllOdd.cF_frozen: 9 <= n -> Frozen n (q n) (cF n) (Recol.Frozen form: proper and no proper colouring differs at exactly one vertex)
theorems.AllOdd.cF_sees: 9 <= n -> Sees n (q n) (cF n): every vertex v and colour col != cF v has a neighbour u with cF u = col
theorems.AllOdd.cL_proper: n odd, 9 <= n -> Proper n (q n) (cL n)
theorems.AllOdd.cLn_not_frozen: n odd, 9 <= n -> not Frozen n (q n) (cLn n hn) (cL embedded in n colours; colour n-1 unused)
theorems.AllOdd.chromaticNumber_eq: (Blow n (q n)).chromaticNumber = m n = 2 q + 1 exactly
theorems.AllOdd.colourClass_card_le: 2 <= n -> each colour class of a Proper colouring of Blow n q has <= n/2 vertices
theorems.AllOdd.cycle_indep_card_le: T : Finset (Fin n), (forall i in T, succ n i notin T) -> 2 * T.card <= n
theorems.AllOdd.dominating: forall n >= 9, t < n: exists j < q n with support n j = t, or support n j + 1 = t, or support n j = (t+1) % n (the gap-2/3 set dominates C_n)
theorems.AllOdd.fold_proper: (2) n odd, 9 <= n -> Proper n (q n) (cL n) /\ m n < n
theorems.AllOdd.fold_step: n odd, 9 <= n, i < n: fold n ((i+1) % n) is fold n i +- 1 modulo m n (every C_n edge, incl. the closing one, maps to a C_m edge)
theorems.AllOdd.frozen_reachable_eq: a frozen colouring is its own connected component of RGraph n q k
theorems.AllOdd.nonrecolorable_blowup: (3) n odd, 9 <= n -> (exists proper (2q+1)-colouring) /\ 2q+1 < n /\ (exists frozen proper n-colouring) /\ (exists proper n-colouring that is not frozen)
theorems.AllOdd.not_proper_of_le: n odd, 9 <= n, k <= 2 q n -> no Proper colouring with k colours (k classes of size <= (n-1)/2 cover < n q vertices)
theorems.AllOdd.proper_frozen_n: (1) n % 2 = 1 -> 9 <= n -> Proper (cF n) /\ Sees (cF n) /\ Frozen (cF n)   [oddness not used]
theorems.AllOdd.support_ne_succ: support n k' != support n k + 1 for all k, k' (independence: no two consecutive residues)
